title: Humanoid Manipulation Interface: Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation from Robot-Free Demonstrations
summary: HuMI collects robot-free wrist imagery and five-keypoint whole-body trajectories with real-time robot-feasibility preview, then trains a 5 Hz visuomotor policy and 50 Hz whole-body tracker for autonomous Unitree G1 manipulation.

metadata.evaluation_scope: five real-world whole-body tasks on one custom-gripper Unitree G1
metadata.license_note: Link and original summary only; no paper text, figures, dataset, or model artifacts are redistributed.
